experiment.claim: Art pairings outperform single-card crops on reach.
experiment.role: This is the SECOND settled pairing the hypothesis needs. The first is the Arita post at 127,200 views; the three settled crops are 941, 926 and 867.
experiment.standing: One pairing against three crops is currently about 135x in the pairing's favour - and note that the ORIGINAL claim in this repo said the opposite, five to one for crops, on readings taken before either post had settled.
refutedIf: The 48h reading lands at or below 2,800 views. That is roughly 3x the settled crop mean of 911, and a pairing that cannot clear 3x a crop does not support a claim built on a 135x gap.
It lands inside the crop band at all - 867 to 941 - which would say the Arita result was about the Arita post and not about the shape.
experiment.wouldStrengthenIt: A 48h reading above 10,000 views, which is an order of magnitude clear of the crop band and could not be a sampling accident at n=2.
confoundsNotControlled: Hour is held at 21:15, the same slot as the Arita post - deliberate.
Follower count has moved from 21,554 to 21,555 since the Arita post, which is nothing.

Subject differs: Charizard and Blastoise are far more famous than Magmar. If this underperforms, subject fame is the first thing to suspect, not shape. This is the confound I cannot control and it is the reason a single result here settles nothing on its own.
n=2 either way. Two pairings is the minimum the hypothesis asks for, not a sample.
experiment.writtenBefore: the post was sent - the falsifier is not to be edited afterwards
